name: What is the process for installing a new sump pump?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing a new sump pump?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with digging a sump pit in the lowest part of your basement or crawl space, if one doesn't already exist. Next, the sump pump is placed in the pit, and a discharge pipe is routed from the pump, usually through a wall or rim joist, to carry water away from your home's foundation. This pipe needs to discharge water at least 10-20 feet away from the foundation to prevent it from re-entering. Finally, the pump is connected to a dedicated electrical outlet. CG Plumbing Solutions ensures the entire process adheres to best practices for effective water diversion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation involves digging a sump pit, placing the pump, routing a discharge pipe away from the foundation, and connecting it to power. We ensure proper water diversion.
